title: Efficient split-state non-malleable codes approaching capacity

import_provenance.original_title: Efficient split-state non-malleable codes approaching capacity
import_provenance.original_statement: Construct explicit, polynomial-time encodable and decodable, information-theoretic non-malleable codes against arbitrary independent tampering of two shares, with negligible error and rate approaching 1/2. This strengthens the split-state constructions developed by Aggarwal, Dodis and Lovett toward the information-theoretic capacity.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial continuation of Dodis’s constructions; the later rate-1/3 result does not attain capacity. Computational-security or additional-state constructions do not settle this information-theoretic two-share target.
